detail.text: Count every delivery line before posting and compare the counted quantity with both the delivery note and the purchase order.
The tolerance for posting as counted is up to 2% of the ordered quantity or 2 units, whichever is smaller. Post such deviations as counted with a note in the goods receipt.

Because the smaller value applies, the limit is 2 units for ordered quantities of 100 or more (2% is then at least 2). For ordered quantities below 100, 2% of the ordered quantity is the limit, which is below 2 units.
Do not post a larger deviation until the shift lead has confirmed a recount.

Do not use the old 5% tolerance from revision 2. Revision 3 (effective 2026-01-01) reduced the tolerance to 2% or 2 units and applies on 2026-10-07.
